hypothesis: The flashed D114 P2 r1 chain boots from disk to postmarketOS with USB RNDIS and key-only SSH, enabling runtime wifi validation against the v46 baseline.
discriminator: Within the timebox after 'fastboot reboot', the RNDIS gadget enumerates and 'ssh lmi@172.16.42.1 uname -a' succeeds (positive) or no RNDIS/SSH appears (negative); UNKNOWN transport parses do not count as negative.
next_if_positive: Read-only wifi state capture (iw dev, cnss state, script/sudoers diff vs v46 note), then runtime lmi-wifi-start scan-only check.
next_if_negative: Record evidence, return device to fastboot via volume-down+power, plan vault recovery boot path; no further writes without a new receipt.

result.note: SSH never appeared; initramfs shell reached. v46 boot image over D114-family userdata (root UUID absent) plus kpartx missing from initramfs.
